title: 第11章 始皇的考验赢天的战力第12章 收十二祖巫魔与道
slug: 全球守护灵开局获得东皇帝俊
content_zh:
始皇点头道：“不错，自从你说小天的天运帝眸觉醒后，寡人便有所猜测。”
“但，那也仅仅只是猜测。”
“所以寡人才会询问你，关于这伙人的势力情报与处事风格。”
“在知道这伙人的性质之后，寡人敢肯定。”
“小天肯定已经通过天运帝眸，知道了这疯人院，没有被覆灭的信息。”
“可…可既然小天知道疯人院没被灭掉，为何不将这个消息告诉我？”赢鸿半信半疑道。
始皇不屑的看着赢鸿道：“告诉你？告诉你，有什么用？”
“沉浸在胜利与和平的喜悦中的你，会信吗？”
“就算你信了，那么得到这个消息后的你，会怎么做？”
“这…”赢鸿被问的哑口无言。
始皇看着这副模样的赢鸿越看越烦。
随后说道：“还不把你这副无能的模样收起来？”
“如果不是为了小天，寡人真想把你的族长之位废掉！”
赢鸿苦笑道：“让先祖失望了。”
始皇丝毫不给赢鸿面子的说道：“你知道就好，都三十五了还没有一点族长的担当，烂泥扶不上墙！”
赢鸿刚想反驳便被始皇打断道：“行了，寡人没时间跟你废话。”
“你现在要做的就是，处理好你手中的事情，还有寡人交给你的任务。”
“若是没什么事儿，寡人就先走了。”
说完直接化为一道龙影向着赢天所在的方向飞去。
看着二话不说就走的始皇，赢鸿张了张嘴，最后陷入了沉默之中。

内心之中不断吐槽：淦，合着我就是一个，套取情报的情报筒？
用完了就扔在一旁，扔掉之后还要骂上几句？〒_〒
……
另一边，始皇在得到想要的消息后，便再一次来到了赢天练武的演武场内。
就这样静静的看着拼尽全力修炼的赢天。
这一看便从闷热的下午，看到了夕阳西下的傍晚时分。
此时浑身是汗精疲力尽的赢天拖着疲惫的身体。
将手中长戟放回了原位之后。
便直接盘腿坐下开始冥想修炼恢复体力。
约莫二十分钟后，赢天睁开了那双金色的眼眸。
随后站起身来朝着一个方向看去无奈的说道：“先祖，您还要在那边看多久？”
始皇闻言大笑道：“哈哈哈哈~不愧是拥有天运帝眸的天之骄子啊。”
“比起你那没用的老爹来，要强上太多了。”
content_en:
The First Emperor nodded and said: "Yes, since you said that Xiaotian's Tianyun Emperor's Eyes have awakened, everyone has made some guesses."
"But, that's just a guess."
"That's why I will ask you about this group of people's power information and handling style."
"After knowing the nature of this group of people, I am sure."
"Xiaotian must have learned through the Tianyun Emperor's Eyes that this lunatic asylum has not been destroyed."
"But...but since Xiaotian knows that the lunatic asylum has not been destroyed, why didn't he tell me the news?" Yinghong said half-convinced.
The First Emperor looked at Ying Hong with disdain and said, "Tell you? What's the use of telling you?"
"Would you believe it if you are immersed in the joy of victory and peace?"
"Even if you believe it, what will you do after you get the news?"
"This..." Yinghong was speechless when asked.
The First Emperor became more and more annoyed when he saw Ying Hong looking like this.
Then he said: "Why don't you put away your incompetent look?"
"If it weren't for Xiaotian, I would really want to depose you as the patriarch!"
Yinghong smiled bitterly and said, "I disappoint my ancestors."
The First Emperor said without giving Ying Hong any face: "As long as you know, you are already thirty-five and still don't have any responsibilities as a clan leader. Mud can't hold up the wall!"
Just as Ying Hong was about to refute, the First Emperor interrupted: "Okay, I don't have time to talk nonsense with you."
"What you have to do now is to handle the matters in your hands and the tasks assigned to you."
"If nothing happens, I will leave first."
After saying that, he turned into a dragon shadow and flew towards Yingtian's direction.
Seeing the First Emperor leaving without saying a word, Yinghong opened his mouth and finally fell into silence.
I kept complaining in my heart: Gan, co-author, I am just an intelligence canister to extract information?
Just throw it aside after using it, and then curse a few times after throwing it away? 〒_〒
…
On the other side, after the First Emperor got the news he wanted, he once again came to the martial arts field where Yingtian practiced martial arts.
Just like this, he quietly looked at Yingtian who was practicing with all his strength.
At this glance, I saw the sweltering afternoon and the evening when the sun was setting in the west.
At this time, Yingtian, who was covered in sweat and exhausted, dragged his tired body.
After putting the halberd in his hand back to its original position.
He sat down cross-legged and began to meditate and practice to regain his strength.
About twenty minutes later, Yingtian opened his golden eyes.
Then he stood up and looked in one direction and said helplessly: "Ancestor, how long are you going to look over there?"
Hearing this, the First Emperor laughed and said: "Hahahaha~ He is indeed the proud man of heaven with the eyes of the Emperor of Destiny."
"Compared to your useless father, he is much better."
